the development and evaluation of a mobile app that provides decision support for the management of patients diagnosed with hypertension, in the context of primary health care in a middle-income setting.
the implementation of a CDSS for the management of patients in primary care in a middle-income context, with the aim of improving the quality of care and the health of the population.

the development of a decision support system to help the management of hypertensive patients, and the evaluation of its usability, feasibility, and utility in the context of primary care in the city of Brazil.
